title: Vaporesso ECO Nano Replacement Pods - 2 Pack
description: The Vaporesso Eco Nano is an ultra-compact pod kit ideal for beginners. With a powerful 1000mAh battery, Corex mesh coils for outstanding flavour, inhale activation, and quick refilling, it's the ultimate choice for an easy-to-use, refillable pod kit. This pack contains 2 x 2ml capacity replacement pods featuring an integrated 0.8ohm coil or 1.2ohm coil. Experience an intensely satisfying MTL vape with rich, long-lasting flavour and a satisfying throat hit, thanks to the Corex Heating Tech within the coil. This technology ensures even heating of the e-liquid and helps to prolong the coil's lifespan. No need to worry about messy coil changes – once it begins to lose flavour just recycle your old pod and insert a new one. It's that simple. Refilling the Vaporesso Eco Nano Pod is simple too. Lift the silicone stopper on the bottom of the pod to access the fill port. The pod securely attaches into the Eco Vaporesso ECO Nano via a secure magnetic connection. There are no buttons or settings to fuss over; fill the pod, wait 5 minutes, and you’re ready to vape. The auto inhale sensor will turn the device on and instantly vaporize your e-liquid. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
